column1: # eve-offline build registry (R-BUILD §3.4; owner decision O17). The source of
# truth for which client builds the tools (tools/dogma.py, tools/content.py) and
# the server (eve-marshal::build::BUILDS, whose test parses this file) accept.
# tools/client-pin.sha256 pins FILES of one install; this pins MEANING.
#   line       release line: codename (start.ini `codename`); one line shares
#   status     pinned      the build the RE corpus is anchored to (exactly one)
#              unverified  seen, not measured: refused by default
#   data_hash  a content bundle data_hash proved equal for this build, or -
#   evidence   how the status was earned
